scope: Independent read-only review of final V2 measured evidence; no new benchmark or production changes.
conclusion: Final identities, complete paired workloads, accepted phase intervals and gate counts verified. No new correctness blocker found. Active CPU/latency parity and a flat RSS plateau are not established.

environment.test_execution: x86_64 release binary under Rosetta on ARM hardware

combined_rss_method: For each accepted whole-phase snapshot, sum app RSS and simultaneous observed descendant RSS; take each run median, then median/range over the three runs. This is a resident address-space sum, not private or proportional memory.

leading.raw_bmp_omission: Raw BMP captures remain in the private capture directory; their recorded hashes were verified before collection.

common.raw_bmp_omission: Raw BMP captures remain in the private capture directory; their recorded hashes were verified before collection.

quick_open.raw_bmp_omission: Raw BMP captures remain in the private capture directory; their recorded hashes were verified before collection.

limitations: Headless hidden SDL fixture; no native compositor, OS keyboard delivery or visible clipboard UX is measured.
The persistent new terminal shell contributes to descendant idle RSS; it is separate from app RSS.
Polling ps is an external observer with scheduling overhead, retained in raw sample timings.
Whole observer intervals crossing observed phase markers are excluded; marker timestamps include log reader scheduling delay.
CPU counters have platform-dependent resolution; vanished/short-lived descendants can be undercounted.
Fast phases may have no ps sample; operation latency remains in events rather than inventing zero resource usage.
Three pairs describe this machine and warm local temporary storage, not universal hardware/OS guarantees.
RSS sums child address spaces and may double-count shared pages; it is not proportional/private memory.
The prebuilt binary hash is recorded; release profile is validated against the supplied frozen-build manifest when present, otherwise caller supplied.
No universal low-resource or performance-parity claim follows from three pairs on this machine.
Observed final settled RSS grows after both later cap crossings; bounded store/index/working sets do not imply a flat allocator RSS plateau.
CopyAll workloads differ after eviction: new record/index metadata shares the 8 MiB disk budget and leaves less retained plaintext.

The first new small command took 2.908 s with little app CPU; read-only trace localized waiting to early helper startup, but its mechanism remains unproven and this headless fixture does not establish visible GUI first-command latency.
Native Windows, native Intel macOS, native Linux x86_64 and fish runtime remain external gates; Windows evidence here is compilation only.
